title: Business Travel
completion_message: ¡Buen viaje! Has aprendido el vocabulario clave para manejar viajes de negocios y viáticos.

parts.visual:
Términos en el aeropuerto: 
- Itinerary (Itinerario). 
- Boarding pass (Pase de abordar). 
- Layover (Escala). 
- Delay (Retraso). 
Ej: My flight has a two-hour layover in Paris (Mi vuelo tiene una escala de dos horas en París).
parts.audio: Airport terms. Itinerary. Boarding pass. Layover means a stop between flights. Delay means the flight is late. For example: My flight has a two-hour layover in Paris.

parts.visual:
Términos financieros del viaje: 
- Expenses (Viáticos / Gastos). 
- Receipt (Recibo / Factura). 
- Reimbursement (Reembolso de gastos). 
Ej: Keep your receipts to get reimbursement for your travel expenses.
parts.audio: Financial terms for travel. Expenses are the money you spend. Receipt is the paper proving you paid. Reimbursement is when the company pays you back. For example: Keep your receipts to get reimbursement for your travel expenses.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta relacionada con viajes de negocios.

questions.question: I need to check my ____ to see what time the meeting starts. (Itinerario).
Please show your ID and your ____ pass at the gate. (Pase de abordar).
There is no direct flight. We have a ____ in Frankfurt. (Escala).
Due to bad weather, there is a two-hour ____. (Retraso).
Don't forget to keep all your ____ for the hotel and meals. (Recibos / Comprobantes).
You need to submit your travel ____ report by Friday. (Gastos / Viáticos).
questions.explanation: Travel expenses = gastos de viaje / viáticos.

questions.question: The company will process your ____ next week. (Reembolso de gastos).
questions.explanation: Reimbursement = reembolso (específicamente devolver el dinero que un empleado gastó de su bolsillo).

questions.question: I need to book my ____ in advance to get a good price. (Vuelo).
Our flight ____ from terminal 3. (Sale / Parte).
questions.explanation: Depart = partir / salir (término oficial de aeropuerto).

questions.question: What is the estimated time of ____? (Llegada).
Did you ____ into the hotel yet? (Registrarte).
questions.explanation: Check in = registrarse (en hotel o aeropuerto).

questions.question: I prefer an ____ seat so I can get up easily. (Asiento de pasillo).
questions.explanation: Aisle (se pronuncia 'ail') = pasillo. Aisle seat = asiento de pasillo.

questions.question: I will wait for you at the baggage ____ area. (Reclamo de equipaje).
Is breakfast included in the room ____? (Tarifa).
questions.explanation: Room rate = tarifa de la habitación.

questions.question: The ____ desk will help you rent a car. (Recepción / Conserjería).
questions.explanation: Concierge = conserje (ayuda con reservas, autos, restaurantes en el hotel).

questions.question: I only have one piece of ____ luggage. (Equipaje de mano).
The flight is ____. There are no seats left. (Sobrevendido).
I need to take a ____ to the airport. It's cheaper than a taxi. (Transporte del hotel/aeropuerto).
questions.explanation: Shuttle = autobús de enlace / transporte de cortesía.

questions.question: We usually fly in ____ class to save money. (Clase turista/económica).
I'm travelling on ____. (Por negocios).
questions.explanation: Travel on business = viajar por negocios.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de viajes de negocios.

questions.question: Ask for a ____. (Reembolso de gastos con R)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase de viaje de negocios.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I need to check my itinerary.
options: I need to check my itinerary.
I need to print my itinerary.
We need to check the itinerary.
I need to check my schedule.
questions.correct_answer: I need to check my itinerary.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: Please show me your boarding pass.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We have a layover in Frankfurt.
options: We have a layover in Frankfurt.
I have a layover in Frankfurt.
They have a layover in Frankfurt.
We had a layover in Frankfurt.
questions.correct_answer: We have a layover in Frankfurt.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The company will process your reimbursement.
options: The company will process your reimbursement.
The company will process your refund.
questions.correct_answer: The company will process your reimbursement.
